faq.q: Who can edit my Reels and TikToks every month?
faq.a: A freelance editor, a social media agency or an editing subscription. ContentFellow's Creator Fellow edits 8 short videos a month plus a motion graphics video and a podcast for £119.

faq.q: How much should I pay someone to edit TikToks?
faq.a: Typically £20 to £50 per simple captioned TikTok from a UK freelancer, and £80 to £150 for heavier edits. Monthly plans bring the cost per video down.

faq.q: Can I try it before paying?
faq.a: Yes. The Creator Fellow starts with 3 free videos, no card needed.

faq.q: Do you post the videos as well?
faq.a: Editing is the Creator Fellow. Posting is the Social Fellow: Manage + Post at £129 a month, or get both in the Growth Fellow.
No. Plans are monthly and you can change or cancel from the next month.
